---
title: natbib document without citations
format: pdf
cite-method: natbib
bibliography: natbib.bib
biblio-style: style-not-installed
_quarto:
  tests:
    pdf:
      noErrors: []
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'generating bibliography'
        negate: true
---

This document uses `cite-method: natbib` but cites nothing, so the `.aux` file has `\bibstyle` and `\bibdata` but no `\citation`.
BibTeX must not run for it, as in TinyTeX's `latexmk()`, which runs BibTeX only when all three are present.

The style is deliberately not installed: if BibTeX ran, it would fail to open the `.bst` and the render would fail.
Templates that always set a bibliography style, such as the `quarto-journals/springer` format, hit this with any document without citations.
